scope: Binary64 minimax reoptimization on the exact 2,113-row cut design, adding ten canonical columns whose reduced-cost scores were independently certified strictly positive by 128-bit Arb against the parent 152-column dual. This is a finite discovery LP, not a theorem. A sub-1/3 result requires exact probability rationalization, a fresh Arb audit of all 2,113 rows, and a complete 63,133-orbit sixth-order separation scan.
